description: The forge workshop includes a true arched furnace cavity and shallow lining, stone piers and log store, tapered riveted extraction hood, open flue with sculpted smoke, coal bed and fire. The foreground anvil has a flared waist, tapered horn and cut-out hardy socket. Other modules include a small stump-mounted anvil, tool racks, swords, horseshoes, hammers/tongs, quenching barrel, coal bucket, workbench, ingot crate and draped leather apron. The sign retains FORGE WORKSHOP on two lines. The stump anvil instances the same GLB at a uniform 0.48 scale; its collider inherits that transform.
differences: The 6.4 × 6.0m footprint, backs and construction dimensions are inferred. Surface wear, heat shimmer, sparks and smoke motion are simplified: smoke is seven static low-poly puffs, fire is the existing sculpted Basic Room flame kit, and quenching water is a static colored surface. Iron uses a matte stylized response and the hanging tool assortment is reduced. The review renderer uses a single small unshadowed forge light; no particle system or new render pass is required.
collision: Simple boxes cover the main furniture, barrels and forge. Furnace arch, chimney throat and anvil socket are modeled as actual openings. Tool use, forging, physics, walking and resource interactions are outside this art-only scope.
